title: Freightliner Cascadia Custom Built Road Train Spec Hi-Tensile Aluminium FUPS Compliant Bullbar with Straight Pipes #18
description: Freightliner Cascadia FUPS Compliant custom built polished high tensile aluminium Bullbar, Custom built heavy duty main channel with provision for Active Brake Assist and Adaptive Cruise Control. Heavy duty box uprights with combination daylight running indicator and park light LED lights in main channel. High tensile 6mm wall polished aluminium 80mm dia. tube recessed welded into the box uprights, no but welds. PolyCarbonate sheeting in front of the headlights for protection. Driving light and Light Bar mounts to customer specifications. Custom built light weight high tensile aluminium backing plate with tow 35mm tow pin. Total weight 130kg. Flip over ROAD TRAIN signs on polished aluminium plates.
